title: Privacy Policy

seo.description: How CHUWU collects, uses and protects your personal data.

body:
CHUWU (“we”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and how you can contact us about it, in line with Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

## What we collect

- **When you order:** your name, email address, mobile number, delivery address, the items you order, any gift message and order notes.
- **For your element balance and scent recommendations:** your date, time and place of birth are used in your browser to calculate your chart and are not sent to us. If you add a recommended scent to your cart, the order shows your Day Master, the elements your chart lacks and your place of birth if you gave one.
- **When you unlock a free Bazi reading:** your email address, first name (if given), gender, date, two-hour time block and place of birth, the chart we calculate from them, and whether you agreed to receive CHUWU news and offers.
- **When you browse:** if enabled, analytics and advertising tools (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) collect information about how you use the site, such as pages viewed and items added to the cart.

## How we use it

To process and deliver your order, confirm your payment, contact you about your order, and improve our website and marketing.

For a free Bazi reading, we use your birth details to calculate your chart and write your reading, and keep them with your email so we can help if you ask about your reading or book a personal one. We only send you news and offers if you ticked the box to agree; you can opt out at any time.

We do not sell your personal data.

## Who we share it with

Only the service providers we need to run the shop: our website host (Netlify), our delivery partner, and — if enabled — Google and Meta for analytics and advertising.

Free Bazi readings are written with the help of an AI service, Anthropic. We send it only your calculated chart (pillars, elements and dates worked out from your birth details) — never your name, email address or contact details.

## How long we keep it

We keep order records only as long as we need them to fulfil your order and meet our accounting and legal obligations, then delete them. We keep free-reading sign-ups until you ask us to delete them.

## Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you, or withdraw consent to marketing, by emailing chuwu.fragrance@gmail.com. We’ll respond within 30 days.

## Contact

For any privacy question or request, email chuwu.fragrance@gmail.com.
